There is no chaos. It is possible that both species survive. ▪ For n = 4 Lotka-Volterra systems there are cases with chaotic behaviour and cases where with organised (integrable) behaviour. ➢ 4D chaotic cases are bounded, so all species co-exist at all times and display rich complexity. ➢ 4D organised cases are unbounded: not all species survive.
